bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · MACD 下穿，位于 $173

read.en: Bloom Energy fell 2.2% on Nov 17 to $173.46, trading $162.93–181.16. It is below the 5-day ($190.8), 10-day ($187.5), 30-day ($217.6), 100-day ($233.7) and 200-day ($223.8). MACD crossed below its signal on Nov 17, below zero, after the histogram faded; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 4 ($213.00), and RSI is 39.3.

The close slipped under the Nov 16 low ($173.90), breaking the $173.5 support, while the $162.93 low briefly undercut $167.5–168.8 before buyers stepped in. Resistance is $181.2–183.2 (Nov 17 and 16 highs), then $185.4–187.5 (Nov 10 close, 10-day) and $190.8–193.9. Support is $167.5–168.8 (Nov 5 close, Nov 6 low), then $162.9 (Nov 17 low) and $156 (Nov 5 low). A close above $183.2 would target $185–187.5; below $167.5, $162.9–156.

r.en: Nov 17 high $181.16; Nov 16 high $183.20; Nov 16 low $173.90, lost
